text:
Maya: Quick review 3 autoscale UI issues: min/max labeling ambiguity and pool-search jitter when there are many pools. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/autoscale

Ken: Confirmed in usability test. User thought 'Min' was per-pool and increased cluster spend. Need clearer scope and maybe a confirmation for cluster-wide changes.

Sasha: Recommendation: compact label + info icon tooltip. Tooltip: 'Applies to all selected pools unless you choose a single pool.'

Jamal: Accessibility: announce stepper changes via aria-live on commit. Debounce announcements when holding keys.

design-bot: Contrast check: stepper value color fails AA; recommend darker text or semibold.

Ken: Pool search fix: keep last suggestions visible until server returns or show client-side prefix filter. I prefer keeping results to avoid flicker.

Sasha: Show contextual CTA when no pool matches: 'Request pool' or 'Create pool' depending on permissions.

Maya: For SLO slider: arrows = 1%, PageUp/Down = 10%, announce summary on commit: 'SLO set to X% 3 est. latency impact Y%'.

Jamal: I'll implement aria-live announce. Ken: can you handle search persistence? Sasha: you'll prototype copy and mobile placement?

Ken: Yes, patch tomorrow morning.

Sasha: Mockups by EOD.

Maya: I'll file the ticket and add an a11y checklist to PR template.

design-bot: Ticket REDWOOD-1428 created: https://tracker.example.com/REDWOOD-1428
